profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at athenahealth

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Practice Agile/Scrum methodology
•	Migrate from monolith system to a microservice system 
•	Build RESTful APIs 
•	Add FHIR support to an HL7 interface engine 
•	Front+Backend transition of NCPDP SCRIPT standard version 10.6 to 2017071

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Enhance and maintain an HL7 interface engine (Perl)
•	Develop and maintain internal tools (Perl, JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
•	Build queries to investigate issues and generate reports (Oracle)
•	Identify and address tech debt (Perl)
•	Triage, distribute, and work escalated tasks with an expected same day turnaround time

(Remote since 03/2016)

positions.title: Firmware Intern
positions.description:
•	Design and implement new features and GUI for existing firmware test tool (Python)
•	Debug and edit test scripts (VBScript)
•	Triage firmware issues

positions.title: Engineering Services Intern III
positions.description:
•	Design and implement a large scale database (MySQL)
•	Develop internal tools and their web interfaces (Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
•	Integrate multiple tools to work in unison
•	Adhere to the Agile methodology

positions.title: Engineering Services Intern II
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain internal tools (Python)
•	Manage a database used by internal tools (MySQL)
•	Coordinate with remote offices to standardize internal tools (Travel: Domestic)

positions.title: Systems Intern
positions.description:
•	Administer Windows via Active Directory
•	Oversee desktop support, hardware replacement, software distribution, troubleshooting
•	Train new desktop support staff

positions.title: Research and Teaching Assistant (Object Oriented Programming)
positions.description:
(Professor David Rilett)
•	Code Java Swing applications
•	Research Socket Programming
